app.title: Uncle Alchemist
app.tagline: Mix the elements. Solve the grid.
menu.prototypeNote: Prototype: your progress is saved on this device only.
stages.title: Stages
game.pausedHint: The board is hidden while the clock is stopped.
game.resetBody: All placed elements and notes will be cleared and the clock restarts.
game.quitBody: Your progress on this puzzle will be lost.
game.notQuite: Not quite. Something is out of place.
game.rules: Every row, column and gold-outlined region holds each element once. Coloured cages hold the ingredients of their recipe.
game.peekHint: Place these ingredients in this cage, in any order.
game.selectCell: Drag an element onto a hole, or select a hole and tap an element.
survival.title: Survival
survival.intro: Solve as many puzzles as you can before the clock runs out. Boards grow from 4×4 to 7×7 every three puzzles.
survival.ruleStart: You start with {time} on the clock and {lives} lives.
survival.ruleBonus: Each solve adds time: +{a}s on 4×4, +{b}s on 5×5, +{c}s on 6×6, +{d}s on 7×7.
survival.ruleMistake: A rule-breaking placement costs a life and {seconds} seconds.
survival.ruleScore: Bigger boards score more, and fast solves earn a speed bonus.
survival.quitBody: Your run ends now and this score will not be saved.
survival.lockedBody: Collect enough stars in the stages to unlock {world}, then Survival opens.
options.title: Options
options.highlightConflictsHint: Mark clashing elements in red. Mistakes still count when this is off.
options.highlightSameHint: Ring every copy of the selected element.
options.showTimerHint: For stages. Survival always shows its countdown.
options.vibrationHint: Buzz on mistakes, on phones that support it.
options.reduceMotionHint: Turn off bouncing and sliding animations.
options.resetHint: Deletes every star, best time and your Survival best on this device.
options.resetBody: All stars, best times and your Survival best on this device will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
recipes.title: Recipe Book
recipes.intro: Each chapter adds the elements and recipes you meet in that world. Base elements have bronze rims, two-element recipes silver, three-element recipes gold.
recipes.noRecipes: No recipes yet. Learn the four base elements first; recipes start in World 2.
